pl.footer: files encrypted on your device · links that wait for the receiver · straight from browser to browser
pl.way.linkText: Anyone with the link downloads, also when you are offline. Encrypted on your media servers.
pl.way.peopleText: Sealed into {app}: friends or a group, in their conversation.
pl.way.directText: From this page to theirs while both stay open. Nothing is stored anywhere; any size.
pl.tooBig: A file is larger than {max}: media servers do not take it. Send it directly.
pl.tooMany: More than {n} files: put them in an archive, or send them directly.
pl.dropText: or tap to choose · nothing leaves your device until you choose how to send
pl.pastePlaceholder: Got a link? Paste it here
pl.error.badLink: This link does not open: it was copied incompletely, or it is not a Payload link.
pl.error.gone: These files are not there any more: the sender deleted them, or the server let them go.
pl.error.noServers: No media server to put the files on: choose one in the settings.
pl.error.tooMany: At most {n} files in one link.

pl.uploadingText.one: {n} file, {size}: encrypted here, then to your media server.
pl.uploadingText.other: {n} files, {size}: encrypted here, then to your media server.

pl.linkNote: Whoever has the link downloads the files until you delete them under Links. The key is in the link itself, so pass it on like a key.
pl.sendToHint: The files are encrypted here and go to your media server once; each person or group gets a sealed message in {app}.
pl.receivedEmpty: Files people send you in {app} show up here.

pl.deleteText.one: {n} file is deleted from your media server; the link opens nothing any more.
pl.deleteText.other: {n} files are deleted from your media server; the link opens nothing any more.

pl.deletedSome.one: Removed here; {n} file stayed on a server that did not delete it.
pl.deletedSome.other: Removed here; {n} files stayed on a server that did not delete them.

pl.linksEmpty: Links you make show up here, on every device you sign in on.
pl.linksNote: Links are kept in your account, encrypted with your key. Deleting one removes its files from the media server.
pl.openNote: Each file is checked against its hash and decrypted on this device; the server only ever held encrypted bytes.
pl.direct.waiting: Waiting for the sender. Their Payload page has to be open: the files go straight from their browser to yours.
pl.direct.changed: The sender is sharing other files now. Ask for a new link.
pl.direct.hashingText: Hashing {size} so the other side can check every piece.
pl.direct.message: Files for you, straight from my browser (keep the page open until they arrive): {link}
pl.direct.fingerprintSender: the receiver sees the same code.
pl.direct.fingerprintReceiver: ask the sender whether theirs matches.
pl.direct.keepOpen: Keep this page open until they are done: the files go straight from here to them. Anyone with the link can download them while you share.
pl.direct.nobody: Nobody yet: send them the link.

pl.direct.allDone.one: {n} file done: every piece matched its SHA-256 hash.
pl.direct.allDone.other: All {n} files done: every piece matched its SHA-256 hash.

pl.settings.serversText: Links and files sent to people go to your media servers, encrypted: the same ones your photos and files in the other apps use.
pl.settings.noServers: No media server chosen: links and sending to people need one.
pl.settings.relayOnlyText: No direct connection: slower, but the other side does not learn your IP address. On this device.
pl.how.1: One drop, three ways: a link waits on your media servers, encrypted, until you delete it; files to people arrive sealed in their conversations; a direct transfer goes from browser to browser and is stored nowhere.
